title: NIS 2 cybersecurity measures
description: Questions for the security owner and evidence checks for essential and important entities under Directive (EU) 2022/2555 (NIS 2), as transposed into national law. These rules do not establish compliance.

rules.instruction: Ask the security owner whether the organization is an essential or important entity under the national law transposing NIS 2 (Art. 3), and record which national text applies.
rules.verification: Link the recorded answer and the national text from the change.

rules.instruction: Keep a vulnerability handling and disclosure process for the changed system, such as a SECURITY.md that names the reporting channel (Art. 21(2)(e)).
rules.verification: Open the repository's security policy and check the reporting channel and the triage owner.

rules.instruction: When the change adds a direct supplier or service provider, ask the security owner to record its security assessment (Art. 21(2)(d) and 21(3)).
rules.verification: Check that the supplier register links the assessment.

rules.instruction: Ask the security owner whether administrative access to the changed system requires multi-factor authentication (Art. 21(2)(j)), and configure it where required.
rules.verification: Inspect the identity provider or access configuration for the administrative roles of the changed system.

rules.instruction: Use the cryptography and encryption choices of the entity's policy (Art. 21(2)(h)) for the data the change stores or transmits.
rules.verification: Compare the configured algorithms, key lengths and TLS settings with the policy.

rules.instruction: Include the changed system in backup management and disaster recovery (Art. 21(2)(c)).
rules.verification: Link the latest recovery test record that covers the system.

rules.instruction: Ask the security owner who sends, for a significant incident, the early warning within 24 hours, the notification within 72 hours and the final report within one month (Art. 23(4)), and record them in the incident runbook.
rules.verification: Open the incident runbook and check the names and deadlines of each step.
